technology_name: FABRICATION OF A SELF-POWERED PHOTODETECTOR OPERATING BASED ON THERMO-DIFFUSION EFFECT IN IONIC LIQUID
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Solid-state semiconductor light sensors encounter heavy leakage currents, performance degradation at volatile temperatures, and require continuous external voltage biasing loops.
description: An innovative design of a self-powered photodetector constructed on a cellulose paper platform embedded with an ionic liquid [EMIM][EtSO4] (1-Ethyl-3-methylimidazolium ethylsulfate), a photo-absorber layer, and a silver spot array to leverage thermo-diffusion charge splitting.
applications: Zero-bias optical communication networks, thermal-gradient power harvesting sensors, wireless telemetry decoders, and flexible wearable optical arrays.
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
